# TPC-DS-OBT Q77

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH ss AS (SELECT obt.store_s_store_sk AS s_store_sk, SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(obt.net_profit) AS profit FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY') AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.store_s_store_sk), sr AS (SELECT obt.store_s_store_sk AS s_store_sk, SUM(obt.return_amount) AS returns, SUM(obt.return_net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.returned_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY') AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.store_s_store_sk), cs AS (SELECT obt.call_center_sk, SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(obt.net_profit) AS profit FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY')) AND channel = 'catalog' GROUP BY obt.call_center_sk), cr AS (SELECT obt.call_center_sk, SUM(obt.return_amount) AS returns, SUM(obt.return_net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.returned_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY')) AND channel = 'catalog' GROUP BY obt.call_center_sk), ws AS (SELECT obt.web_page_wp_web_page_sk AS wp_web_page_sk, SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(obt.net_profit) AS profit FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY') AND obt.web_page_sk = obt.web_page_wp_web_page_sk) AND channel = 'web' GROUP BY obt.web_page_wp_web_page_sk), wr AS (SELECT obt.web_page_wp_web_page_sk AS wp_web_page_sk, SUM(obt.return_amount) AS returns, SUM(obt.return_net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.returned_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY') AND obt.web_page_sk = obt.web_page_wp_web_page_sk) AND channel = 'web' GROUP BY obt.web_page_wp_web_page_sk) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, ss.s_store_sk AS id, sales, COALESCE(returns, 0) AS returns, (profit - COALESCE(profit_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM ss LEFT JOIN sr ON ss.s_store_sk = sr.s_store_sk WHERE ss.s_store_sk = sr.s_store_sk UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, cs.call_center_sk AS id, sales, returns, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM cs, cr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, ws.wp_web_page_sk AS id, sales, COALESCE(returns, 0) AS returns, (profit - COALESCE(profit_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM ws LEFT JOIN wr ON ws.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wp_web_page_sk WHERE ws.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wp_web_page_sk) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel, id LIMIT 100
```
